<!-- pr-reviewer: 3914606bfa1de0f90879d5d90f207749c1dd7cf2 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** Not built by the reviewer (see "Results").

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR adds a new toolpath generator path (rest Adaptive from the stock of the previous operations).

### What looks good

- The default is off. An operation without the group keeps its stamp. The stamp byte `0xD9` and the allowance are written only when the group is on (`crates/app/src/operation/params.rs:319-328`).
- The refusals stand at the edit and again at generation (`generate.rs:758-765`). The entered previous tool, the Trochoidal method, arc turns, a tilt, bad values and no stock ahead are each refused by name.
- `grown` (`rest_prior_adaptive.rs:121-139`) only adds material, and the result is cut to the region. `the_allowance_never_makes_the_standing_material_smaller` pins this.
- The wall band stays in the stock for each plunge and each load reading. Only the plan of passes ignores it. The path note states the film.
- The guard switches (`Guards`) and their pins are a good pattern. The app pin checks each plunge against an independent simulation of the roughing pass.
- The PR diff over its base (#2822) moves no golden (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `*.png`) and changes no `testdata/`. I checked this.
- Provenance lines are present. The decision record is complete. No new dependency between our crates.
- The UI change is one pattern line (`rest: _` in `mill2d_page.rs:333`). It has no visible effect, so no screenshots are necessary. The page rows are #2884.
- MCP: the group uses the existing `edit_operation`. The skill row is #2885 (P5, area:mcp).

### Results

- **Trial merge with `upstream/main` (17b1b2b81): CONFLICT in code**, 9 files:
  - `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`
  - `crates/app/src/operation/params.rs`
  - `crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs`
  - `crates/app/src/project/params.rs`
  - `crates/app/src/project/params_impl.rs`
  - `crates/app/src/project/pocket_adaptive_migrate.rs`
  - `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs`
  - `crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest2d.rs`
  - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs`

  The parent #2822 is also `CONFLICTING`.
- **Not built.** I started a local build of the PR head. The shared compile cache (sccache) on the review machine did not respond, and no crate compiled in more than 30 minutes. This is a fault of the review machine, not of the PR. Thus I ran no suite, no clippy and no mutation. "Not built" is not a pass.
- Mutations re-run by the reviewer: none (not built). The table in the PR body is not checked.
- Heavy lanes run by the reviewer: none (not built).
- Extra suites run: none owed. The diff changes no `testdata/` and no importer code.

### Requested before merge

1. **Heavy lanes (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review", #2568).** The diff changes `crates/motion/src` and `crates/app/src`. By `xtask/src/heavy.rs`, the diff thus reaches the `motion` and `app` heavy lanes. The PR body names no heavy lane. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Then add the lanes and their results to the body.
2. **Conflicts.** Merge `main` into #2822 first, and then into this branch (never rebase). The two sides both add lines in `rest2d.rs`, `machining2d/mod.rs` and the `Adaptive2D` constructor lists. Keep the two sides. Do the quick gate again on the merged head.

### Notes (not blocking)

- With the group on, the `entry` field and the links are not read (decision record, "Limits"). The result is safe, because each entry is a plunge into space that is proved clear. But this PR refuses the Trochoidal method and arc turns so that no option is dropped silently. Think about a path note or a refusal for a Helix or Ramp entry too.
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` is 4020 lines. It was over the 400-line limit before this PR, and the PR adds about 24 lines.
- After the two items above, a full review must build the merged head, run the touched suites and clippy, and do two mutations again (for example "the refusals stand at generation" and "the film put back to one cell diagonal").

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: No findings fixed. The merge stopped at conflicting changes to the same logic, as required by the fixer instructions.

- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`, `run_job_arms`, Adaptive2D planner dispatch: this branch adds previous-operation stock dispatch and rest refusals. Main adds corner-relief validation and planning in the same block.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest2d.rs`, `rest_pocket` / `rest_pocket_with_relief`: this branch extracts `emit_rest` for both rest modes. Main changes the same block to plan and emit corner-relief paths.

Evidence: `git merge upstream/main` at main `ab9955105` reported nine conflicting files. The combined diff shows the overlapping logic above. I aborted the merge. No files were changed or pushed.

Head remains `3914606bfa1de0f90879d5d90f207749c1dd7cf2`. Parent PR #2822 also remains conflicting. I did not change that PR.

The quick gate, clippy, heavy lanes, and mutation checks were not run. There is no final merged head to validate. The heavy-lane finding remains open.

Please re-review after the parent and these logic conflicts are resolved and the final head passes the required checks.

**Needs changes before merge.** Safety review. Local checks passed on the PR head. The trial merge still fails.

This is a same-head re-review after the later [Addressed comment](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2890#issuecomment-7033869728).
I checked the two findings in the [earlier review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2890#issuecomment-7033848134). Both remain open.
The later comment gives conflict evidence. It states that no finding was fixed.

**What looks good**

- The default stays off. The rest group changes the stamp only when it is on.
- The edit and generation paths refuse unsupported modes by name.
- The stock reading uses the cut depths of the rest planner. Uncertain material stays occupied.
- The independent simulation pins pass. They check cutter clearance, coverage, load, and rapid moves.
- The app pins pass for undo, redo, the project file, and MCP editing.
- The UI pins pass for the source selector, hidden tool fields, Apply, and undo.
- The UI rows and MCP documentation have open follow-ups: #2884 and #2885.

**Local results**

Rules checked: current upstream `AGENTS.md` at `3ffe2338f775b2f254524f5f8e642aae5181aebb`.
Its rules match those read at the start of this review.

The trial merge with that main fails in nine code files. I aborted it without a resolution.
All tests and clippy below ran on the unchanged PR head `3914606bfa1de0f90879d5d90f207749c1dd7cf2`.
There is no test result for a merged tree.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **PASS**, 359 steps, 0 failed, 122.9 minutes.
- Three builds with `--no-run`: **PASS**, motion, app, and UI.
- 356 test steps: **4,682 passed, 0 failed, 83 ignored**.
- UI tests ran from `crates/ui`. Pixel snapshots did not run.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **PASS**, 8 minutes 22 seconds.
- `git diff --check`: **PASS**.

**Mutations run again locally**

I ran both existing guard-switch tests in the motion library suite. Both passed.
Each test enables all guards, then disables one guard at a time.
Red below means that the pin becomes false with its guard disabled. The harness checks that expected failure.
Green means that the pin holds with all guards enabled. No source edit was needed.

| Guard | Disabled pin | Enabled pin |
|---|---|---|
| Adaptive entered-source refusal | red | green |
| Adaptive missing-stock refusal | red | green |
| Adaptive allowance growth | red | green |
| Prior stock: every depth | red | green |
| Prior stock: unreadable columns | red | green |
| Prior stock: outside the grid | red | green |
| Prior stock: cell growth | red | green |

Pins: `machining2d::rest_prior_adaptive::tests::each_guard_is_pinned_and_its_removal_fails_the_pin`
and `machining2d::rest_prior::tests::each_reading_guard_is_pinned_and_its_removal_fails_the_pin`.

**Extra suites run**

None required by the extra selection rules. The PR diff changes no test data, fixture, or golden file.
It changes no STEP, mesh, or model importer code.

**Goldens and heavy lanes**

No golden changed in the PR diff. The diff over the stack parent also changes no `.nc`, `.cl`, or `.png` file.

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches both motion and app heavy lanes, with 219 planned steps.
The heavy tests were **not run** in this review. The PR body provides no result for these lanes.
Ignored tests in the quick gate are not a heavy-lane pass.

**Requested before merge**

1. **Resolve the code conflicts at merge time.** [crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:755](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/3914606bfa1de0f90879d5d90f207749c1dd7cf2/crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs#L755) and eight other files conflict with main.
   The earlier conflict finding remains open. Resolve the parent #2822 first, then this branch, at the permitted merge-time refresh.
   Run the gate on the resulting head. Obtain the review required by the refresh class.
2. **Record the required heavy-lane results.** [crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest_prior_adaptive.rs:97](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/3914606bfa1de0f90879d5d90f207749c1dd7cf2/crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest_prior_adaptive.rs#L97) changes the motion path and reaches the app lanes too.
   The earlier heavy-lane finding remains open. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head.
   Add the lane names and results to the PR body.
3. **Add before/after UI screenshots to the PR body.** [crates/ui/src/egui_app/rest_pocket_page.rs:45](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/3914606bfa1de0f90879d5d90f207749c1dd7cf2/crates/ui/src/egui_app/rest_pocket_page.rs#L45) adds the visible `Rest stock from` selector.
   This change comes from the stack parent and remains in this PR's diff against main. The body has no before/after screenshots.
   Store the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body.
